description.value: Belias does not need to eat.
Belias does not need to sleep.

This Burst Mode lets Belias roars as his fires grow stronger and hotter. For a number of rounds equal to 1 + 1 round for every four HD, the fire on his melee attacks grows to 2d6. Additionally, his fire spells are treated as if they are 1 DC higher, and Flame Bolt's range increased to 30 ft. and explosion increase to 90 ft. respectively. This limit break requires only a swift action to activate.

effect: Activate Gigas Flame for [[1 + floor(@attributes.hd.total/4)]] rounds. +1 fire spell DC, 2d6 melee fire, altered Flame Bolt.

description.value: Once every 1d3+1 rounds as a standard action, Belias sets his halberd ablaze and shoots a javelin of fire from the tip, traveling up to 60 ft. away and exploding at his target hitting all of those within 20 feet away dealing 10d6 points of fire damage and those within the blast radius make a Reflex save (DC 26) for half damage.

Burst text literally specifies 30-ft range and 90-ft explosion; normal bolt is 60 ft / 20 ft.

description.value: Once every 1d4+1 rounds as a standard action, Belias digs his hands into the ground and causing an eruption of magma around himself within 30 ft. away. Those caught in the geyser must take 12d6 points of fire damage and are inflicted with the Burning status effect for 2d4 rounds effect unless they make a successful Reflex save (DC 26) for half damage and negating the burning status effect. Blue Mages may learn this ability as a 6th level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC26).
